title: B: wall lines, paper title, layout cleanup
description: Baseline B: the four A-WALL lines, the paper TEXT "FLOOR PLAN" on A-101, the title block's attribute text style set to NOTES (block.define gives attribute definitions the current style, Standard, which ac-025.text-styles-listed flags), and the deletion of Layout1 and Layout2 (no op deletes layouts). Run after 12, with A-101 current.

args.code:
(progn
 (vl-load-com)
 ((lambda ( / doc ms lays res try bylayer setprops mkline mkpline paperblock ptext)
   (setq doc (vla-get-ActiveDocument (vlax-get-acad-object))
         ms (vla-get-ModelSpace doc)
         lays (vla-get-Layouts doc)
         res nil)
   (defun try (tag fn / r)
     (setq r (vl-catch-all-apply fn nil))
     (setq res (cons (list tag (cond ((vl-catch-all-error-p r) (strcat "FAILED: " (vl-catch-all-error-message r)))
                                     (r "ok")
                                     (T "FAILED: returned nil"))) res)))
   (defun bylayer (o)
     (vla-put-Color o 256) (vla-put-Linetype o "ByLayer") (vla-put-Lineweight o -1) o)
   (defun setprops (o lay props)
     (vla-put-Layer o lay) (bylayer o)
     (foreach p props (vlax-put-property o (car p) (cadr p)))
     o)
   (defun mkline (lay p1 p2 props)
     (setprops (vla-AddLine ms (vlax-3d-point p1) (vlax-3d-point p2)) lay props))
   (defun mkpline (lay pts closed width / flat o)
     (foreach p pts (setq flat (append flat (list (car p) (cadr p)))))
     (setq o (vla-AddLightWeightPolyline ms (vlax-make-variant (vlax-safearray-fill (vlax-make-safearray vlax-vbDouble (cons 0 (1- (length flat)))) flat))))
     (vla-put-Closed o (if closed :vlax-true :vlax-false))
     (vla-put-ConstantWidth o width)
     (setprops o lay nil))
   (defun paperblock (name) (vla-get-Block (vla-Item lays name)))
   (defun ptext (layout str x y h style lay / o)
     (setq o (vla-AddText (paperblock layout) str (vlax-3d-point x y 0.0) h))
     (vla-put-StyleName o style)
     (vla-put-Layer o lay)
     (bylayer o))
   (try "wall-s" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(0.0 0.0 0.0) '(240.0 0.0 0.0) nil))))
   (try "wall-e" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(240.0 0.0 0.0) '(240.0 180.0 0.0) nil))))
   (try "wall-n" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(240.0 180.0 0.0) '(0.0 180.0 0.0) nil))))
   (try "wall-w" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(0.0 180.0 0.0) '(0.0 0.0 0.0) nil))))
   (try "paper-title" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-101" "FLOOR PLAN" 2.0 2.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "attdef-style" (function (lambda () (progn (vlax-for e (vla-Item (vla-get-Blocks doc) "TB-ARCHD") (if (= (vla-get-ObjectName e) "AcDbAttributeDefinition") (vla-put-StyleName e "NOTES"))) T))))
   (try "attrib-style" (function (lambda () (progn (vlax-for e (paperblock "A-101") (if (and (= (vla-get-ObjectName e) "AcDbBlockReference") (= (strcase (vla-get-EffectiveName e)) "TB-ARCHD")) (foreach a (vlax-invoke e 'GetAttributes) (vla-put-StyleName a "NOTES")))) T))))
   (try "delete-Layout1" (function (lambda () (progn (vla-Delete (vla-Item lays "Layout1")) T))))
   (try "delete-Layout2" (function (lambda () (progn (vla-Delete (vla-Item lays "Layout2")) T))))
   (reverse res))))
args.purpose: Baseline B: four wall lines, paper title text on A-101, title block attributes in style NOTES, delete Layout1 and Layout2.
